items.title: 63475_Arnett Cobb oral history interview
items.q: on that band was a guy by the name of Chester Boone that liked my playing, and he had formed a band in Houston... Now, we went out like 3 months all over the state of Louisiana

ctx.x: No, I said Chester. C-h-e-s-t-e-r, Chester Boone
Oh, Chester Boone. He was a saxophone player, wasn't he?
